description: Asks to save the callback address an AI app shows for one of the workspace's sign-ins, so people can sign in through it. Copilot Studio's starts with https://global.consent.azure-apim.net/redirect/. It replaces the address saved now. Owners and admins only. Nothing happens until you approve it in CodeGene: the answer gives a link to the request, which waits there for 15 minutes. Send the person that link; you cannot approve it. Then call get_approval with the requestId to learn how it ended.

callback_url.description: The callback address the app shows, pasted exactly.

client_id.description: The sign-in's Client ID (list_sign_in_clients gives them).

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: save_sign_in_callback
title: Save an AI app's callback address
